title: MCP Multi-Client Compatibility Matrix
scope: This matrix records documented client entry points and a repeatable test plan. It is not a live compatibility certification: no multi-client run has been measured in this repository, so transport, discovery, policy, and runtime behavior remain not-measured or test-required for the named client version, server version, operating system, configuration, and authorization.

statusLegend.documented: The cited documentation names the entry point or configuration surface; it is not proof of a current live run.
statusLegend.not-measured: No controlled live run is recorded for this client and context.
statusLegend.test-required: Run the listed client-specific test before making a compatibility claim.

rows.documentedSurface: Claude Code /mcp status panel and tool count
rows.testRequired: Record the Claude Code version; connect the same server in MCP Inspector and Claude Code, compare initialize, tools/list, tool count, authentication, scope, and deferred Tool Search behavior.

rows.documentedSurface: Cursor MCP settings and installed-version logs; interface labels can vary
rows.testRequired: Record the Cursor version and client surface; compare the same server and authorization in Inspector and Cursor settings/logs, including enabled-tool filters, refresh, and invocation.

rows.documentedSurface: Copilot CLI /mcp or copilot mcp get <name>
rows.testRequired: Record the Copilot surface and version; compare the same server in Inspector and Copilot, then check enabled-tool filters, custom-agent policy, authentication, refresh, and schema errors.

rows.documentedSurface: Client-specific connection status, logs, policy, and refresh controls
rows.testRequired: Record client and server versions, OS, transport, authorization, config scope, and expected tools; compare the client result with the same server in Inspector.
